subject: prd/pipeline-measurement
statement: When a pipeline phase completes, the system shall record one per-phase run record carrying the phase identity, the run/feature id, and — for each model the phase used — the input/output/cache token quartet.
fit_criterion: for a reference run, every completed phase yields exactly one record whose per-model token quartet reconciles to the harness's own accounting — exact where the harness reports an authoritative per-model total, else within the design-set tolerance (Q2)
